captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a pair of night-vision porro-prism binoculars colored in a dark olive green and matte black. It consists of two wide objective barrels with offset prism housings connected by a central bridge assembly. At the front of each barrel, there is a flat flip-up lens cap mounted on a small hinge pin, while the rear features cylindrical black eyepieces. The main barrels can rotate symmetrically around a central revolute hinge for interpupillary adjustment, and the lens caps can flip open via their respective hinge joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a night-vision porro-prism binocular with olive green barrels, offset prism housings, and black eyepieces. The model should include a central revolute joint connecting the left and right barrels for interpupillary adjustment, and flip-up objective lens caps on revolute hinge joints at the front of each barrel.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining an ArticulatedObject. The central bridge/hinge serves as the base link. The left and right barrel assemblies are modeled as separate parts, each composed of a main cylinder, an offset box-like prism housing, and a rear eyepiece cylinder. These barrel assemblies are connected to the central hinge via revolute joints. Flat rectangular lens caps are defined as separate parts and attached to the front of each objective barrel using revolute joints representing the flip-up hinge pins.
